column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:sift module
# aql:sift — the semi-structured-text tier (design/SIFT.0.md). Six format
# families (kv, blocks, columns, dsv, fixed, pattern) register as `parse`
# kinds; the Sift namespace defines/introspects them; a spec-map is a parser
# expressed as data. Rows lead with `import "aql:sift"` (and `import

column3: the six format families, in order
kv splits on the first separator; values are strings by default

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'integer'} "a: 1\nb: 2") dot a
column3: vtype coerces every value

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' names:'normalize'} "MemTotal: 4") dot mem-total
column3: names:'normalize' kebab-cases the key

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' names:'normalize' vtype:'size'} "MemTotal: 16297200 kB") dot mem-total
column3: vtype:'size' scales a kB value to Integer bytes
unquote strips one matched quote pair
repeat:'first' keeps the first value
repeat:'last' keeps the last value
repeat:'list' collects duplicates into a list
repeat:'error' rejects a duplicate key
a line with no separator raises under the default strict
strict:'skip' drops the malformed line

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'integer' strict:'skip'} "a: x\nb: 2"
column3: strict:'skip' drops a coercion failure

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'integer'} "a: x"
column3: a coercion failure raises under the default strict
an unknown repeat mode is a spec error

column1: # §3  blocks — blank-line-separated kv blocks → List of Maps

column3: two blank-separated blocks (kvsep defaults to ':')

column1:
import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  size (parse blocks {sep:'indent'} "eth0:
  a: 1
lo:
  b: 2")
column3: sep:'indent' starts a block at each unindented line
an unknown block separator is a spec error

column1: # §4  columns — whitespace-aligned table with header → Table

column3: the header row is consumed; two data rows
header:false requires fields

column1: # §5  dsv — delimited rows, no header → Table

column3: dsv with a literal separator and named fields
default auto-names c1..cN
fixed-width by consecutive widths
fixed needs cols or widths

column1: # §7  pattern — regex with named groups → Map / Table

column3: named groups become fields
a non-participating optional group yields None
pattern requires at least one named group
no match raises under the default strict
no match under strict:'skip' yields None
an inline spec parses without registering
an unknown family in an inline spec is a spec error
an unknown kind name is rejected

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  Sift.define ex {family:'kv' opts:{sep:'='}} end  parse ex "a=1"
column3: a defined kind is an ordinary parse kind

column1: import "aql:sift"  Sift.define ex {family:'kv'} end  (Sift.spec ex) dot family
column3: Sift.spec returns the merged spec

column1: import "aql:sift"  Sift.define ex {family:'kv'} end  Sift.define ex {family:'dsv'}
column3: a genuine re-definition collides
a name that collides with a family is rejected
a capitalised kind name is rejected
Sift.spec on an unknown kind is rejected

column1: import "aql:sift"  Sift.define m {family:'kv' detect:{path:["/proc/meminfo"]}} end  Sift.detect "/proc/meminfo"
column3: detect resolves a path to its kind
an undetected path yields None

column1: import "aql:sift"  Sift.define p {family:'columns' detect:{cmd:{match:["ps"]}}} end  Sift.detect ["ps" "aux"]
column3: detect resolves an argv0 basename to its kind

column1: import "aql:sift"  Sift.define a {family:'kv' detect:{path:["/x"]}} end  Sift.define b {family:'kv' detect:{path:["/x"]}}
column3: two kinds cannot claim one path
Sift.kinds lists every registered kind (the six families at import)
a valid spec yields no issues
check reports the issue code
check reports an unknown-key issue without raising

column1: # §11  coercions, preprocessing, and family options (branch coverage)
import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'float'} "a: 1.5") dot a
column3: float coercion

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'boolean'} "a: yes") dot a
column3: boolean coercion accepts yes/no/on/off/1/0

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'boolean'} "a: nope") dot a
column3: a non-boolean value raises

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'percent'} "a: 55%") dot a
column3: percent strips the sign to a Float

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'auto'} "a: 42") dot a
column3: auto infers Integer

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'auto'} "a: 4.5") dot a
column3: auto infers Float

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'auto'} "a: true") dot a
column3: auto infers Boolean

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'auto'} "a: hello") dot a
column3: auto falls back to String

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'size'} "a: 2 MiB") dot a
column3: size understands MiB

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' vtype:'integer'} "a:") dot a
column3: an empty cell under a typed column is None
an unknown vtype is a spec error

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse kv {sep:':' skip:1} "drop\na: 1") dot a
column3: skip drops leading lines
chop drops trailing lines
comment drops full-line comments
a negative skip is rejected
an unknown strict mode is rejected

column1: # §12  columns / dsv / fixed / pattern option branches
import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse columns {fields:['a' 'b']} "H1 H2\n1 2") dot 0 dot a
column3: fields override consumes but ignores the header

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse columns {} "%CPU CMD\n9 top") dot 0 dot cpu
column3: headers normalize (%CPU → cpu)

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse columns {label:'kind'} "used free\nMem: 9 1") dot 0 dot kind
column3: label mode names the row by its first token

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  ((parse columns {fields:['a' 'z2'] header:false} "one two three") get 0) get 'z2'
column3: the last column is greedy

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse dsv {limit:2 fields:['a' 'b']} "x y z") dot 0 dot b
column3: dsv limit makes the last field greedy

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse fixed {cols:[[0 3] [3 -1]] fields:['a' 'b']} "abcdefg") dot 0 dot b
column3: fixed cols with -1 reaching end of line
cols and widths are mutually exclusive spans vs fields count

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  (parse pattern {re:'(?P<n>\\d+)' per:'line' vtype:'integer'} "x 1\ny 2") dot 0 dot n
column3: pattern per:'line' yields a row per matching line

column1: import "aql:sift"  import "aql:parselang"  size (parse pattern {re:'(?P<n>\\d+)' per:'line' strict:'skip'} "a\nx 1")
column3: per:'line' with strict:'skip' drops non-matching lines
an unknown per mode is rejected
a malformed regexp is a spec error

column1: # §13  spec-map, opts overlay, and blocks table

column3: call-site opts overlay the spec's opts
blocks table:true builds a Table

column1: import "aql:sift"  Sift.define fk (fn [[source:String opts:Map] [List] [source]]) end  (Sift.spec fk) dot family
column3: a fn kind reports family:'fn'
a fn without the [source opts] prefix is rejected
an inline family:'fn' spec parses via its fn
